comments.text: The Panama figure is the one that moves most year to year, and not because of shipping. Gatun Lake is a rainfall reservoir, and every transit spends fresh water to lift a ship 26 metres and then throws it to the sea, so a dry year cuts the number of daily slots. In 2023 and 2024 the canal rationed transits for drought, which is a chokepoint limited by weather rather than by width.
